meta.title: ARMY Adria – A Community Platform Built in Two Weeks | LumiVerse
meta.description: A BTS fan with no coding background built a full Croatian fan-community platform – magazine, archive, games, member accounts – in two weeks with AI.

en.title: ARMY Adria
en.subtitle: A complete BTS fan-community platform for Croatia and the region – an editorial magazine, a deep video and discography archive, five games and full member accounts. One devoted fan, with no coding background, built it herself in two weeks: AI tools in her hands, LumiVerse's build model behind her. Her love; our AI.

The Zajednica community hub with custom illustrated cards for games and regional meetups
A 'Which BTS member are you?' personality quiz with a progress bar and answer cards

sections.title: Her Love, Our AI Build Model
sections.lede: We gave a lifelong BTS fan with no coding background the right AI tools and a little guidance – then got out of the way.

items.title: The Part No Model Has
items.body:
She brought the ingredient AI can't supply: taste, obsession, and love for the subject. She knew exactly what her community wanted because she is that community – a BTS fan from Croatia who wished a place like this existed.

Every one of the 90-plus articles is hers. Every game, every category, every bit of Croatian copy comes from someone who actually cares.

items.title: What We Provided
items.body:
Not a development team. An AI build model, a production stack that could scale from a simple quiz to authenticated member accounts, and guidance whenever she hit a wall.

The engineering barrier came down. The person did the rest – and the person turned out to be more than enough.

sections.title: Not a Landing Page – a Platform
sections.lede: Two weeks in, it's a content-and-community portal – editorial, media, games and accounts in one place, not a fan page with a few links.

items.title: Editorial Magazine
items.body: 90-plus original Croatian articles – BTS stories, news and guides – across their own categories.

items.title: Video Archive
items.body: A curated library with a rich taxonomy: MVs, Run BTS, FESTA, Bangtan Bomb, dance practices, per-member solo videos and specials.

items.title: Full Discography
items.body: Every release, with in-page listening – the whole catalogue in one browsable place.

items.title: Events Calendar
items.body: Birthdays, anniversaries and releases – the dates the community lives by, in one calendar.

items.title: Newcomer Guide
items.body: Who's who, a glossary, a timeline, eras & albums and membership how-tos – an on-ramp for new fans.

items.title: Five Games & Quizzes
items.body: "Which member are you?", three-level trivia, emoji song-guessing, a word search and album match – with progress saved to your profile.

items.title: Member Accounts
items.body: Registration, login, password reset and a personal profile – with full, GDPR-compliant account management.

items.title: Personalization
items.body: Playlists, favorites, video playlists and article likes – the site remembers what each fan cares about.

items.title: Site-wide Search
items.body: A quick command-style search across everything – articles, videos, discography and games.

sections.title: How Two Weeks Was Enough
sections.lede: Fast didn't mean flimsy: one person moved like a small team, on a stack built for production from day one.

items.title: One Person, Moving Like a Team
items.body: With AI generating, refactoring and explaining alongside her, she designed the interface, wrote the content and built the features in parallel – the work of a small team, done by one.

items.title: Production From Day One
items.body: Not a prototype. Real accounts with hashed passwords, a proper database and GDPR-compliant account management – the boring, essential parts done properly, not faked.

items.title: Cleared Before It Launched
items.body: An unofficial fan project done right: the content was run through a BTS/HYBE legal review before going live, and the site states plainly that it isn't affiliated with BTS, HYBE or BIGHIT.

items.title: Under the Hood
items.body: A modern, production-grade stack – the kind you'd expect behind a funded product, shipped by someone who'd never touched any of it two weeks earlier.
Next.js 16 (App Router)
React
TypeScript
Tailwind CSS
NextAuth (email/password, bcrypt)
Prisma ORM
libSQL (SQLite-compatible)
Docker
Dokploy on Hetzner

sections.title: The Barrier Was Never the Code
sections.lede: For years, an idea like this needed a budget and a developer. Now it needed a fan who wouldn't quit.

paragraphs: AI didn't replace a team – it removed the reason she needed one. That's not a slogan for us; it's the experiment, run on a person instead of a client. "AI tools that make humans unstoppable" is exactly what a full community platform, built in two weeks by one devoted fan, looks like.

items.body: Dedication and taste are the scarce inputs – AI supplies the rest
A non-developer can now ship a real, authenticated product
Guidance beats hand-holding: unblock, don't take over
Done right means done properly – real auth, real legal clearance

meta.description: BTS obožavateljica bez programerskog predznanja izgradila je cjelovitu platformu fan zajednice — magazin, arhiva, igre, računi — u dva tjedna, uz AI.

hr.title: ARMY Adria
hr.subtitle: Cjelovita platforma za BTS fan zajednicu Hrvatske i regije — uređivački magazin, opsežna videoarhiva i diskografija, pet igara i potpuni korisnički računi. Izradila ju je sama, u dva tjedna, jedna predana obožavateljica bez programerskog predznanja: AI alati u njezinim rukama, LumiVerseov model izrade iza nje. Njezina ljubav, naš AI.

sections.title: Njezina ljubav, naš AI model izrade
sections.lede: Dugogodišnjoj BTS obožavateljici bez znanja programiranja dali smo prave AI alate i malo vodstva — i maknuli se s puta.

items.title: Dio koji nijedan model nema
items.body:
Donijela je sastojak koji AI ne može dati: ukus, opsjednutost i ljubav prema temi. Točno je znala što njezina zajednica želi jer ona jest ta zajednica — BTS obožavateljica iz Hrvatske koja je priželjkivala da ovakvo mjesto postoji.

Svaki od više od 90 članaka njezin je. Svaka igra, svaka kategorija i svaki redak hrvatskog teksta dolaze od nekoga kome je doista stalo.

items.title: Što smo mi dali
items.body:
Ne razvojni tim. AI model izrade, produkcijski stack koji se mogao protegnuti od jednostavnog kviza do korisničkih računa s prijavom, i vodstvo kad god bi zapela.

Inženjerska je prepreka pala. Ostalo je napravio čovjek — i pokazalo se da je čovjek više nego dovoljan.

sections.title: Nije stranica, nego platforma
sections.lede: Nakon dva tjedna to je portal za sadržaj i zajednicu — uredništvo, mediji, igre i računi na jednom mjestu, a ne fan stranica s poveznicama.

items.title: Uređivački magazin
items.body: Više od 90 originalnih hrvatskih članaka — priče o BTS-u, vijesti i vodiči — razvrstanih u vlastite kategorije.

items.title: Videoarhiva
items.body: Kurirana knjižnica s bogatom podjelom: spotovi, Run BTS, FESTA, Bangtan Bomb, plesne probe, solo videi po članovima i posebna izdanja.

items.title: Cijela diskografija
items.body: Svako izdanje, uz slušanje na samoj stranici — cijeli katalog na jednom mjestu za prelistavanje.

items.title: Kalendar događanja
items.body: Rođendani, obljetnice i izdanja — datumi po kojima zajednica živi, u jednom kalendaru.

items.title: Vodič za pridošlice
items.body: Tko je tko, pojmovnik, vremenska crta, razdoblja i albumi te upute za pridruživanje — ulaz za nove obožavatelje.

items.title: Pet igara i kvizova
items.body: „Koji si član?", kviz znanja u tri razine, pogađanje pjesama iz emojija, traženje riječi i slaganje albuma — s napretkom spremljenim na Vaš profil.

items.title: Korisnički računi
items.body: Registracija, prijava, promjena lozinke i osobni profil — uz potpuno upravljanje računom, usklađeno s GDPR-om.

items.title: Personalizacija
items.body: Popisi za slušanje, favoriti, videopopisi i lajkovi na članke — stranica pamti do čega je svakom obožavatelju stalo.

items.title: Pretraga cijele stranice
items.body: Brza pretraga u stilu naredbene trake, kroz sve — članke, videe, diskografiju i igre.

sections.title: Kako su dva tjedna bila dovoljna
sections.lede: Brzo nije značilo krhko: jedna se osoba kretala kao mali tim, na stacku građenom za produkciju od prvog dana.

items.title: Jedna osoba, brzinom tima
items.body: Dok je AI uz nju generirao, preslagivao kod i objašnjavao, ona je dizajnirala sučelje, pisala sadržaj i gradila funkcionalnosti usporedno — posao malog tima, odrađen sam.

items.title: Produkcija od prvog dana
items.body: Ne prototip. Stvarni računi s kriptiranim lozinkama, prava baza i upravljanje računom usklađeno s GDPR-om — dosadni, nužni dijelovi napravljeni kako treba, a ne odglumljeni.

items.title: Odobreno prije objave
items.body: Neslužbeni obožavateljski projekt napravljen kako treba: sadržaj je prije objave prošao pravnu provjeru prema BTS-u i HYBE-u, a stranica jasno navodi da nije povezana s BTS-om, HYBE-om ni BIGHIT-om.

items.title: Ispod haube
items.body: Moderan produkcijski stack — onakav kakav biste očekivali iza financiranog proizvoda, a objavila ga je osoba koja ga dva tjedna ranije nije ni dotaknula.

sections.title: Prepreka nikad nije bila kod
sections.lede: Godinama je ovakva ideja tražila proračun i programera. Sada je tražila obožavateljicu koja neće odustati.

paragraphs: AI nije zamijenio tim — uklonio je razlog zbog kojeg joj je tim trebao. To nam nije slogan, nego eksperiment izveden na čovjeku umjesto na klijentu. „AI alati koji ljude čine nezaustavljivima" izgledaju točno kao cjelovita platforma zajednice koju je u dva tjedna izgradila jedna predana obožavateljica.

items.body: Predanost i ukus rijetki su sastojci — ostalo daje AI
Osoba koja nije programer danas može objaviti pravi proizvod s prijavom korisnika
Vodstvo je bolje od držanja za ruku: odblokiraj, ne preuzimaj
Napravljeno dobro znači napravljeno kako treba — prava prijava, prava pravna provjera
